text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Yui, having made a quick escape from the guildhouse, 
eventually returns to finish cooking.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ギルドハウスを飛び出したユイは
しばらく経って戻ってきて、無事に料理を作り終えた。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Here we go. Fresh omurice, right off the pan. Sorry for the wait.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お待ちどうさま。
特製オムライスの出来上がりだよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh baby, here we go! Yui's cooking is pretty much chef tier,
so get ready for a treat.
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってました！　
ユイの料理の腕前はシェフ並みだから、
期待しといていいぞ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're just exaggerating.
My family runs a restaurant, so I just kind of picked it up naturally.
Don't expect anything fancy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことないよ。
実家が飲食店だったから、
自然と覚えただけだし。
凝ったこともしてないよ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hey, mind telling me why you came running out the guildhouse?
Did something happen? Don't tell me you got in an argument.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なぁユイ。
さっきはなんでいきなり外に飛び出してったんだ？
何があったんだよ？　
ケンカでもしたのか？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Err, well...
You see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは、
その……
えっと……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
And here I was hanging around, waiting for the right time to head back in.
Oh well, there's food on the table now. That's good enough. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
飯が出来あがりそうな頃を見計らって戻ろうと思ったのによ～
ま、
こうして飯にありつけたからいいけどさ♪

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: You're something else, Makoto.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
マコトちゃんったら……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Aight. Less talking, more eating.
Don't wanna let it get cold!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
せっかく作った飯が冷めちまう。
食べようぜ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Good point. Feel free to dig in, Mr. Knight.
Hopefully it's to your tastes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
騎士クンもどうぞ。
好みの味付けに出来てたらいいんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Chow time.
Yup. That's the good stuff!
Honestly, I wish you'd cook for me every day of the week.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いただきまーす……
うん！　
旨い！
さすがユイ。
これを毎日食わせて欲しいんだけどな。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Thanks. Just don't expect that to actually happen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなにおだてても、
何にも出せないよ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh man, I just had a genius idea.
Hey, {0}. How about you let Yui personally
feed you? I bet it'll taste even better like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これだ！
なぁ{0}、せっかくだからユイに食べさせてもらえよ。
そしたらもっと美味しくなるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: What?! Where did that come from?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトちゃん！？　
いきなり何言い出してるの！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry about that. She just really likes her jokes,
so no need to take her seriously. Okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご、
ごめんね騎士クン。
今のはマコトちゃんの冗談だから！
気にしないで、
ね？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: You are?! P-please don't put me on the spot like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えええっ！　
そ、
そんなこと言われても……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'd like to. I'd [i]really[/i] like to...
It's just... It's too embarrassing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかくの騎士クンからのお願いだし、
叶えてあげたいけど……
ううぅ……
やっぱり恥ずかしいよ～！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Then again. This is my moment, isn't it?
How am I supposed to be brave on the battlefield if I can't even do this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも、
ここで勇気が出せなかったら、
きっと戦う時もおんなじだよね……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll do it.
The food's here. The spoon's here. The courage... is here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……騎士クン。
わたしやってみる。
ちゃんと食べさせてあげられるように、
頑張ってみる！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Atta girl! Show him what you're made of!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よく言ったユイ！　
頑張れよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Hold up. This... ain't quite the romantic episode I was hoping for.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？　
なんか想像してたのと雰囲気が違うぞ……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Right! I'm going in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
……
行きます！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Open wide...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
あーん……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: H-how is it? Does it taste okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ど、
どうかな？　
美味しい？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Phew...
choice_data_list: You should give it a try.
text_block_list.orig_text: 良かったぁ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Good point. *munch*
Mmm! You're right!
I was kind of worried that I'd made it too strong, but this is perf—
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうするね。
あむ……
……うん、
美味しいね♪
ちょっと味が濃いかもって心配だったけど、
これなら……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Did I... Did I just take a bite from the same spoon as him?
Oh lord, I did!
That means we practically kissed...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたし今、
騎士クンに食べさせてあげたスプーンで、
そのまま食べちゃった……！？
これって間接キ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Ah, ahhh...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あわ、
あわわわわ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: *collapse*
text_block_list.orig_text: きゅうぅぅぅ……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Yui?! You okay?!
Come back to us! YUUUIII!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイ！？　
どうしたんだよおい！
しっかりしろ！　
ユイーッ！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: *wither, wither*
text_block_list.orig_text: ぷしゅー……ぷしゅー……
